newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus changes tender deadline for wheat cargo.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus changes tender deadline for wheat cargo.

text.p: The Cyprus Grain Commission has changed the deadline for the submission of tenders for the supply of a combined cargo of 10,000 tonnes of spring and 8,000 tonnes of durum wheat to March 27, it said in a statement.
The commission had earlier issued an announcement saying the deadline expired on March 28.
All other terms in the initial tender issued remain the same, it said. Shipment of the cargo is scheduled to take place between April 5 and 20.
